title: Compare replacement lists by tokens and separation
conditions: Comparing macro replacement lists.
exceptions: Presence versus absence of separation still matters.
rule: Require identical token counts, order, spelling and whitespace-separation positions; whitespace kinds and amounts are equivalent.
cpg_consequence: Keep token-boundary whitespace information.

proposed_checks.description: Lists p + q and p	+  q agree; p+q differs in separation.

title: Restrict object-like macro redefinition
conditions: An object-like macro name is already defined.
exceptions: A preceding #undef removes this redefinition constraint.
rule: A replacement definition must remain object-like with an identical replacement list; otherwise the program is ill-formed.
cpg_consequence: Compare active definitions before replacement.

proposed_checks.description: Define LEVEL as 12 twice: allowed. Redefine it as 13 without undef: diagnose.

title: Restrict function-like macro redefinition
conditions: A function-like macro name is already defined.
exceptions: Renaming a parameter is not equivalent redefinition.
rule: Require function-like form, identical parameter count/spellings and identical replacement lists; otherwise the program is ill-formed.
cpg_consequence: Retain parameter spelling in definition identity.

proposed_checks.description: Repeating #define KEEP(x) x is allowed; changing both x occurrences to y is not.

title: Require argument count and closing parenthesis
conditions: Invoking a function-like macro.
exceptions: Empty arguments have a separate original-edition UB rule.
rule: Match the definition parameter count and provide the terminating closing-parenthesis token.
cpg_consequence: Diagnose malformed invocation without inventing arguments.

proposed_checks.description: For PAIR(x,y), PAIR(4,5) has the right count; PAIR(4) and an unclosed invocation fail these constraints.

title: Keep parameters unique within their definition
conditions: Declaring function-like macro parameters.
exceptions: Parameters do not become persistent macro bindings.
rule: Parameter identifiers must be unique; their scope ends at the newline terminating the definition.
cpg_consequence: Keep parameter substitution local to its definition.

proposed_checks.description: Reject #define DUP(t,t) t; a later source identifier t is not bound by #define ONE(t) t.

title: Use one macro-name namespace
conditions: Defining macro names.
exceptions: C++ block scope does not partition macro names.
rule: The identifier following define is the name; object-like and function-like macros share one namespace.
cpg_consequence: Use the active preprocessing environment rather than C++ symbol scopes.

proposed_checks.description: An active object-like TAG and a new function-like TAG are competing definitions, not overloads.

title: Exclude boundary whitespace from replacement lists
conditions: Capturing a macro replacement list.
exceptions: Internal token separation remains significant to redefinition identity.
rule: Leading and trailing whitespace is not part of either form of replacement list.
cpg_consequence: Preserve boundary source spans separately from semantic replacement content.

proposed_checks.description: Trailing spaces after #define RATE 6 do not change the replacement list.

title: Do not macro-expand directive identifiers
conditions: A lexical # followed by an identifier occurs where a directive can begin.
exceptions: This is not a general ban on expansion inside directive operands.
rule: Do not macro-replace that identifier.
cpg_consequence: Recognize directive names before operand expansion.

proposed_checks.description: With a macro called include, the identifier in #include remains the directive name.

title: Replace object-like macro occurrences
conditions: An active object-like macro occurs as an identifier token.
exceptions: Identifier-like text inside a literal is not a macro-name occurrence.
rule: Replace it with its replacement preprocessing tokens and rescan.
cpg_consequence: Preserve definition and invocation origins.

proposed_checks.description: With #define DEPTH 8, DEPTH becomes 8 while "DEPTH" retains its literal spelling.

title: Recognize function-like invocation across whitespace
conditions: A function-like macro name is followed by ( as the next preprocessing token.
exceptions: Without a following opening-parenthesis token the name is not invoked.
rule: Replace through the matching closing parenthesis, skipping matched nested pairs; newlines inside the invocation are ordinary whitespace.
cpg_consequence: Keep physical invocation spans across lines.

proposed_checks.description: For #define SAME(t) t, SAME followed by newline and (9) invokes; SAME followed by + does not.

title: Split arguments only at outer commas
conditions: Identifying arguments within invocation parentheses.
exceptions: Braces or angle brackets are not parentheses.
rule: Commas inside matched inner parentheses do not separate arguments; other commas do.
cpg_consequence: Track parenthesis depth, not parser expression structure.

proposed_checks.description: PAIR((3,4),5) supplies two arguments; template-like angle brackets alone do not shield a comma.

title: Treat empty original-edition arguments as undefined
conditions: Before substitution, an argument contains no preprocessing tokens.
exceptions: A zero-parameter invocation is distinct; a nonempty argument that later expands away is distinct.
rule: Behavior is undefined in the printed 2003 edition.
cpg_consequence: Label rejection as CPG policy, not a required ISO diagnostic.

proposed_checks.description: ONE() for a one-parameter macro has UB; ZERO() for a zero-parameter macro does not trigger this rule.

title: Classify directive-like argument sequences as undefined
conditions: Argument tokens would otherwise act as preprocessing directives.
exceptions: Ordinary argument tokens lacking directive context are outside this condition.
rule: Behavior is undefined.
cpg_consequence: Retain provenance for optional refusal diagnostics.

proposed_checks.description: Place a directive-shaped line inside an invocation; do not prescribe a conforming expansion result.

title: Require a parameter after stringizing #
conditions: A function-like replacement list contains #.
exceptions: Whitespace between # and its parameter is permitted.
rule: The next preprocessing token must name a parameter.
cpg_consequence: Check definition shape before invocation.

proposed_checks.description: Accept #define SHOW(v) # v; diagnose #define SHOW(v) # other.

title: Classify invalid stringizing results as undefined
conditions: Stringizing fails to produce a valid character-string literal token.
exceptions: Valid raw spelling and escaping are already covered by requirement 000006.
rule: Behavior is undefined.
cpg_consequence: Do not assign a mandatory malformed-result representation.

proposed_checks.description: A case independently established to produce an invalid string token receives no fixed ISO output oracle.

title: Do not assume a stringizing or pasting evaluation order
conditions: A replacement list contains multiple # or ## operations.
exceptions: This does not legalize an invalid paste or stringizing result.
rule: Their evaluation order is unspecified.
cpg_consequence: Avoid storing a chosen processing order as a universal language guarantee.

proposed_checks.description: For several valid pastes, an oracle must permit any order allowed by the stated operations rather than require left-to-right evaluation.

title: Reject ## at replacement-list boundaries
conditions: Either macro form uses token pasting.
exceptions: Leading or trailing whitespace does not hide a boundary operator.
rule: ## must not be the first or last preprocessing token of its replacement list.
cpg_consequence: Validate definitions before expansion.

proposed_checks.description: Diagnose #define BAD(x) x ##; accept an otherwise valid replacement x ## tail.

title: Substitute raw arguments next to ##
conditions: A parameter is immediately adjacent to ## in the replacement list.
exceptions: Subsequent rescanning still applies to the pasted result.
rule: Substitute the argument preprocessing-token sequence without ordinary argument prescan.
cpg_consequence: Keep raw argument tokens distinct from expanded tokens.

proposed_checks.description: With #define PART root and JOIN(a,b) a##b, JOIN(PART,end) first forms PARTend, not rootend.

title: Paste replacement-list operands then rescan
conditions: A ## from the replacement list has valid operands.
exceptions: A ## supplied by an argument is not an operator from the replacement list.
rule: Remove it, concatenate adjacent operand tokens and make the resulting token available for macro replacement.
cpg_consequence: Record both contributing origins on pasted tokens.

proposed_checks.description: JOIN(red,wood) forms redwood; if redwood is an active macro it can expand. Passing x ## y through an ordinary identity macro does not itself paste.

title: Classify invalid token-paste results as undefined
conditions: Concatenated spelling is not a valid preprocessing token.
exceptions: UCN creation has the additional phase-4 rule in requirement 000041.
rule: Behavior is undefined.
cpg_consequence: Treat refusal and source diagnostics as policy.

proposed_checks.description: Pasting + and / does not form a preprocessing token; specify no mandatory output or ISO diagnostic.

title: Do not execute expansion results as directives
conditions: Complete macro replacement produces directive-like text.
exceptions: An original directive with expanded operands remains a separate case.
rule: Do not process that resulting token sequence as a preprocessing directive.
cpg_consequence: Distinguish lexical directives from generated tokens.

proposed_checks.description: A macro expansion yielding # define FLAG 1 must not create a new FLAG definition.

title: Keep macro definitions independent of block scope
conditions: A macro definition is active.
exceptions: Do not carry that environment into an independent translation unit.
rule: It lasts until matching #undef or the translation-unit end, regardless of block structure.
cpg_consequence: Track preprocessing lifetime separately from lexical C++ scopes.

proposed_checks.description: A definition written inside braces remains active after the closing brace unless explicitly undefined.

title: Remove definitions with #undef
conditions: A valid #undef names an identifier.
exceptions: Restrictions on protected predefined names remain separate.
rule: Remove its macro definition; if none exists, ignore the directive.
cpg_consequence: Update only the named preprocessing binding.

proposed_checks.description: After defining LIMIT then undefining it, LIMIT remains an identifier; undefining an ordinary absent name is harmless.

title: Distinguish definition adjacency from invocation whitespace
conditions: Classifying a #define directive.
exceptions: Invocation allows whitespace before its opening parenthesis.
rule: Function-like definition requires an opening parenthesis immediately after the macro name, without whitespace.
cpg_consequence: Retain definition adjacency through comment replacement.

proposed_checks.description: Compare #define PICK(x) x with #define PICK (x); only the first defines a function-like macro.
